name: Gillagréine

attributes.attribute: is an ancient Irish goddess of east County Clare
had a human father and a sunbeam mother

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gillagréine is an ancient Irish goddess, though she remains little known. Her name survives across east County Clare. She learned that her father was human while her mother was a sunbeam. In despair she leaped into the water of Lough Gréine, also called Lough Graney. Her body drifted to Daire Gréine and then came to rest at Tuam Gréine, the sun's tomb. She may have been an early sun goddess.

okr.objective: Document Gillagréine as a regional Irish sun goddess.
